name: Example Tasks
description: Your to-do lists in Example Tasks, with sign-in on its own page
author: Example Author

connect.api: GET /lists returns the lists; GET /lists/<id>/tasks the tasks; POST /lists/<id>/tasks {title, due} adds one.
help: Make an app at tasks.example.com/developers with your server's return address.
Copy its client id into the package's settings, then sign in.
